baseline.setup: If the app is signed out, sign in with the Clerk test account: from the Welcome screen open sign-in or sign-up, enter the +clerk_test address in the QA_TEST_EMAIL key of the gitignored .env, and enter the fixed test-mode code 424242 (it works only for +clerk_test emails on the pk_test development instance). If a pre-filled identifier asks for a password, tap 'Use another method' and choose the email code. Complete any first-run onboarding. The session persists across relaunches through the Clerk token cache.
baseline.launch: The signed-in main screen, with no crash, red screen, stuck splash or fatal error in the launch logs.
